periods.description: The Divine Raiment of Bahamut, compressing and releasing time/phenomena: first slowing an object's time, then accelerating it to explosive speed.

details.mechanism: first five seconds reduce time/energy/phenomena to a fraction; next five seconds accelerate and release them severalfold
details.risk: extreme stamina drain and possible collapse

activation.condition: Bahamut linked and Lux chooses a target phenomenon

effects: lets Bahamut outpace simultaneous enemy attacks
creates a visible slow period followed by an accelerated burst

power_level.peak: defeats roughly one hundred rebel Drag-Rides and Abyss in volume 1

known_feats: Lux destroys multiple Drag-Rides in a single accelerated instant
Airi explains the five-second slow and five-second acceleration cycle
